rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a parcel, box, or envelope that has been sent or received.

example.english: I just received the package you sent.
example.traditional: 我啱啱收到你寄嚟嘅包裹。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 sau1 dou2 nei5 gei3 lai4 ge3 baau1 gwo2

rows.note: Use this specifically for installable software distributed as a package.

example.english: You can install this package directly.
example.traditional: 呢個軟件包可以直接安裝。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jyun5 gin6 baau1 ho2 ji5 zik6 zip3 on1 zong1

rows.note: Use this for a bundled set of components, especially when the emphasis is on the collection as a whole rather than its installation format.

example.english: This software package includes three programs.
example.traditional: 呢個軟件套裝有三個程式。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jyun5 gin6 tou3 zong1 jau5 saam1 go3 cing4 sik1
